cited_by.title: Vitiligo, spread, starting age and treatment options

record.population: 41 adults at a university clinic in Sheffield, UK (37 European Caucasian, 3 Asian Caucasian, 1 Black African)
record.finding: Mean age of onset was 28 years (oldest 74), with 17 of 41 before 20. A family history of vitiligo was given by 7 (18%) and a precipitating factor by 9 (22%), including pregnancy, sunburn and skin injury. Thyroid disease was present in 14 (34%).
record.note: Small, almost entirely European, adults only.
